title: Reviews
description: Collections received from other users for verification. These are read-only copies.

banner.title: Copy received for review
banner.body: The data and scores below were sent by the exporter and cannot be modified here. Attached files are not included in the export.

empty.title: No reviews imported
empty.description: Import a .json file exported by another user to review their collection.

confirm.title: Confirm import
confirm.duplicate: This version was already imported on
confirm.note: The imported copy is read-only and will not be mixed with your own collections.

errors.title: Could not import this file
errors.notFound: Could not open this review. It may have been deleted.
errors.tooLarge: The file exceeds 10 MB — it does not appear to be a collection export.
errors.notJson: The file is not a valid JSON.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save the review. Please try again.

template.modified: Created from the template "{{name}}", with changes to its structure.
template.disputed: The file's label and the recalculated structure disagree about whether it still matches the template "{{name}}". Confirm with the sender.

ok.title: Scores verified
ok.body: Recalculation with this app's scoring engine matches the sent values ({{n}} values checked). This confirms calculations are consistent with file data, not that documents are authentic.

mismatch.title: {{n}} discrepancy(ies) between sent values and recalculation
mismatch.body: May indicate the file was modified, is inconsistent, or that the sender uses a version with different scoring rules. Confirm with sender before approving.

verify.more: and {{n}} more — all marked in the review.
